# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** Eight years old  <sub>[v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 c8 P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005), [v2 c8 P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Dora is a fair child with a straight nose, gentle and mild hazel eyes, and long sleek curls that never get out of order. She often looks neat and proper, frequently dressed in a starched white dress with a black sash.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Dora is extraordinarily meek, quiet, and well-behaved, behaving like a little lady and acting as a model child. She is neat, faithful, observant, and industrious, fulfilling all her small duties systematically and without needing to be told twice. However, she can be somewhat prim, monotonous, and placid, remaining largely unruffled by emotional distress or external disturbances.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c8 P51](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0051), [v2 c10 P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 c26 P32](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0032), [v2 c26 P33](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0033), [v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001)_

## Abilities

- Helping with household and garden chores such as feeding chickens, picking up chips, wiping dishes, and weeding  <sub>[v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010)</sub>
- Learning and reciting hymns, catechism questions, and Bible verses meekly  <sub>[v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030)</sub>

## History

Dora lived with her sick mother and her mischievous twin brother Davy before being taken in by Marilla Cuthbert at Green Gables following her mother's death. She settled into household life easily, aiding Marilla with small chores around the farm and garden. When school started, she began attending alongside Davy, sitting temporarily with Mirabel Cotton and later attending Sunday School. During a severe hailstorm that broke windows and terrified Marilla and Davy, Dora remained quiet and composed. At eight years old, she calmly saw Anne Shirley off to college, eating her breakfast undisturbed while others were tearful.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001)_

- Dora's mother was sick for a long time and her father died when her twin brother was a baby  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033)</sub>
